column1: # Stage S10 H2b, page crate: the operations pages (the event schedule, the event hub with its
# inline slotting, the standalone ORBAT selection page, the service record and the leaderboards)
# become crates/frontend/pages/operations_pages. The folder becomes the crate's `src`, its module
# tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README; the feature docs move to their mirror under
# documentation/crates/frontend/pages/operations_pages. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to
# the moved folder and one `operations_pages::` row scoped to the app's source.
